A general visit to Casa Batlló starts at 29 euros in 2026, according to the house's own online ticket page, and children aged 0 to 12 go free. The starting price is a floor rather than a fixed fare, because the house prices by time slot and demand.

The ticket types

The site lists the General Visit from 29 euros, the Night Visit from 25 euros and the Be the First morning visit at 45 euros. A visit combined with the third floor and breakfast or tapas starts at 65 euros, and the Magical Nights visit with a concert starts at 59. The Gaudí Miró Gomis exhibition on its own is 15 euros, with 3 euros off for juniors, students, seniors and disabled visitors.

Booking ahead is the discount

Casa Batlló advertises that booking in advance saves up to 15 euros per person on some experiences. No separate door price is published, so the difference is between an early booking and a same day one. The house opens every day from 9am to 10:30pm, a long window that helps in finding the cheaper slots.

Worked example

A couple on the cheapest general visit pays 58 euros. Two adults with two children under 13 also pay 58 euros. The same couple choosing the Be the First slot pays 90 euros, so early access costs 32 euros more than the floor price.

Still unclear: the page shows starting prices rather than a full grid, so the real cost on a given date only appears in the booking calendar.

Sources: https://www.casabatllo.es/en/online-tickets/

posts.title: California Academy of Sciences tickets 2026: 49 dollars, 55 at peak
posts.summary: Adult admission is 49 dollars in 2026 and 55 on peak dates, with children aged 3 to 12 at 39 or 45 and ages 2 and under free.
posts.body:
Adult admission to the California Academy of Sciences is 49 dollars in 2026, rising to 55 dollars on peak dates, according to the Academy's own ticket page. The peak surcharge is the part most visitors miss when budgeting.

The price ladder

The Academy publishes adults aged 19 and over at 49.00 or 55.00 peak, youth aged 13 to 18 at 45.00 or 49.00 peak and children aged 3 to 12 at 39.00 or 45.00 peak. Ages 2 and under are free. Visitors with an EBT card pay 5 dollars, which is one of the largest published concessions of any big city museum.

When peak pricing bites

The Academy states that peak pricing applies during spring break, summer months, holiday weekends, and November and December holiday periods. In practice that covers most school holidays, so a family travelling in July should assume the higher column. Opening hours are Monday to Saturday 9:30am to 5pm and Sunday 11am to 5pm.

Worked example

Two adults and two children aged 3 to 12 pay 49 plus 49 plus 39 plus 39 off peak, which is 176 dollars. The same four on a peak date pay 55 plus 55 plus 45 plus 45, which is 200 dollars. Membership starts at 119 dollars a year, so two adults planning a second visit are close to the point where a card wins.

Still unclear: the ticket page does not publish a calendar of peak dates, so the only way to confirm a price is to pick your date in the booking flow.

Sources: https://www.calacademy.org/buy-tickets

posts.title: Teatro Amazonas tickets 2026: 20 reais for the guided visit
posts.summary: The guided visit costs 20 reais in 2026, half price 10 reais, free for children up to 10 and for people born in Amazonas, with a short Sunday window.
posts.body:
A guided visit to the Teatro Amazonas in Manaus costs 20 reais in 2026, according to the Amazonas state culture department's own page for the theatre, with a half price ticket at 10 reais. It is one of the cheapest headline attractions in Brazil.

Who pays what

The full ticket is 20 reais and the half rate is 10. That half rate covers students, teachers, visitors aged 60 and over, blood donors, healthcare professionals, military personnel and companions of disabled visitors, each on proof. Entry is free for people born in Amazonas who can show it, for disabled visitors and for children aged 0 to 10.

Hours and the short Sunday

The theatre receives visitors Tuesday to Saturday from 9am to 5pm, and on Sundays and holidays only from 9am to 1pm. That Sunday window is the trap, because a river trip returning in the afternoon leaves no time at all. Visits are guided rather than free roaming, so you move at the guide's pace.

Worked example

A couple pays 40 reais. Two adults with two children under 11 also pay 40 reais, since the children are free. Two adults and two teenagers on the student rate pay 20 plus 20 plus 10 plus 10, which is 60 reais.

Still unclear: the page does not say whether visit tickets can be bought online in advance or only at the box office, and it does not spell out the Monday position.

Sources: https://cultura.am.gov.br/portal/teatro-amazonas/

posts.title: Corcovado train tickets 2026: 134 reais to Christ the Redeemer
posts.summary: The standard adult fare on the Corcovado train is 134 reais in 2026, with children aged 7 to 11 at 107 and Brazilian seniors at 70.
posts.body:
The Corcovado train to Christ the Redeemer costs 134 reais for a standard adult fare in 2026, according to the railway's own English booking page. The fare covers the ride and the access to the statue platform, which is why it sits well above a normal train ticket.

The fare list

The operator publishes the normal fare at 134.00 reais, children aged 7 to 11 at 107.00, Brazilian seniors aged 60 and over at 70.00, Brazilian students at 107.00, ID Jovem holders aged 15 to 29 at 107.00 and disabled visitors at 107.00. Children under 6 travel free with proof of identity.

The documents rule

Every discounted fare requires official photo identification, and children aged 7 to 11 need a birth certificate or photo identification. The senior and student rates are for Brazilians only, so a foreign visitor aged 70 pays the full 134 reais. Tickets are sold online, by phone, on WhatsApp and through accredited hotels.

Worked example

A couple pays 268 reais. Two adults with two children aged 7 to 11 pay 134 plus 134 plus 107 plus 107, which is 482 reais. Two adults with one child under 6 pay 268 reais, because the youngest travels free.

Still unclear: the page quotes a price for today's visit rather than a season grid, so a high season departure may not cost the same as the figure above.

Sources: https://www.tremdocorcovado.rio/en/
